items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 01 August 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near the Azores, high pressure in the mid-Atlantic.


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in the south this evening and at first tonight, then becoming variable 3 or less later in the night. Settling mainly east or northeast 2 to 4 later in the period.


##State of Sea##

Mainly slight, becoming smooth or slight later.


##Weather##

Fair, then occasional rain spreading from the west later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeast 2 to 4, increasing 4 or 5 overnight, decreasing 2 to 4 again later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate for a time.


##Weather##

Occasional rain spreading from the west.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.
